title: How to Become TikTok Shop Affiliate
summary: A realistic guide to TikTok Shop affiliate eligibility, enrollment, product selection, disclosure, content, and performance review.
body_markdown:
## What a TikTok Shop affiliate creator does


An independent affiliate creator promotes eligible products from sellers through TikTok Shop. The Product Marketplace in Creator Center can provide products to add to a showcase and attach to shoppable content. When a qualifying purchase is attributed under TikTok’s rules, the creator may earn the commission shown for that product or collaboration.


TikTok’s current policy distinguishes independent affiliate creators from marketing creators and official shop creators linked to a seller. These roles have different access and qualification rules. An official shop account promoting only its linked shop is not the same as an independent creator choosing products across the marketplace.


### Understand the commercial relationship


Commission is consideration for promoting a third party’s product. It does not make every order final or every estimate payable. Cancellations, returns, refunds, attribution, settlement, account verification, and policy status can affect eligibility and the final amount. No legitimate application process can guarantee approval, views, orders, or income.
